headline: Verstappen gets a different steering wheel after Friday problems in Brazil
body: Verstappen ended FP2 five minutes early with heavy steering, after complaining about his downshifts in FP1. Red Bull will fit a different wheel for the rest of the weekend and is looking into more changes. He was third in both sessions.

headline: Camara is reprimanded for impeding Leclerc in Brazil FP2
body: Haas debutant Camara received a formal reprimand, stronger than the usual warning, for squeezing Leclerc towards the run-off in FP2. The stewards called the situation clearly dangerous.

headline: Norris says McLaren's Brazil upgrades gave what the team hoped for
body: Norris topped FP1 in the upgraded McLaren and was about two tenths off Mercedes in FP2. He ran half the new parts in each session and the full package comes together for Saturday.
